pokedexEntries.di: It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

pokedexEntries.prl: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

pokedexEntries.pt: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

pokedexEntries.hgss: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

pokedexEntries.bw: At dusk, swarms of them are carried aloft on winds. When noticed, they suddenly vanish.

pokedexEntries.b2w2: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can’t be a fixed destination.

pokedexEntries.x: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

pokedexEntries.or: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

pokedexEntries.y: It’s drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

pokedexEntries.as: It’s drowsy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

pokedexEntries.su: There was once an incident in which a man took a trip riding a Drifblim, only to go missing.

pokedexEntries.mo: Even while under careful observation, large flocks of Drifblim flying at dusk will inexplicably disappear from view.

pokedexEntries.us: There’s a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you’ll be carried away to the afterlife.

pokedexEntries.um: The raw material for the gas inside its body is souls. When its body starts to deflate, it’s thought to carry away people and Pokémon.

pokedexEntries.sw: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.

pokedexEntries.sh: It grabs people and Pokémon and carries them off somewhere. Where do they go? Nobody knows.

pokedexEntries.bd: They’re drowsy in daytime but fly off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

pokedexEntries.shp: It carries people and Pokémon when it flies. But since it only drifts, it can end up anywhere.

pokedexEntries.la: It drifts along at dusk, perfectly silent. Its transient, melancholy aspect touches some people deeply—every so often, one will come upon a song or poem devoted to Drifblim.

pokedexEntries.sc: It can generate and release gas within its body. That’s how it can control the altitude of its drift.

pokedexEntries.vi: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.
